_comment: Placeholder benchmark results. Replace with real training run outputs after ml/training/ scripts are complete.

models.name: LightGBM
models.notes: Winner. Best ROC-AUC and fastest inference on the provider-aggregated feature set. 600 estimators, num_leaves=63, max_depth=7.

models.name: XGBoost
models.notes: Strong runner-up. ROC-AUC within 0.005 of LightGBM but ~4x slower training and ~2.5x slower inference. 600 estimators, max_depth=6, eta=0.05.

models.name: CatBoost
models.notes: Competitive with XGBoost. Handles categorical provider attributes (state, specialty proxy) natively. 1000 iterations, depth=6.

models.name: Logistic Regression
models.notes: Baseline. ~0.09 ROC-AUC gap and far weaker PR-AUC on this imbalanced, non-linear feature set. L2, C=0.01, scaled features.
